title: Fix empty GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL in container tmux sessions

comments.author: anon-31e9bd66
comments.content: start_session exports GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL='' (empty string) when not set. An empty value tells git 'no global config' vs unset which uses ~/.gitconfig. Fix: only export GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL if it was already set.
